column1: # Reference words: labels that make a number a business number, not personal data
# (order, invoice, receipt, shipment ...). One entry per line, `#` comments, blank lines
# ignored; format in pl/references.tsv. A trailing `*` lets the word take suffixes
# (`factur*`: `factura`, `facturii`), a trailing `.` matches with or without the dot.
# The shared check accepts "nr" between the label and the number, not the Romanian
# "numărul"; the stem-changed forms are listed by stem (`comand*`, `comenz*`).
# Every entry is scoped to the rules check for now: the NER check's negative words are pinned
# to the built-in list (tests/detect/test_reference_packs.py, LAB-1788), so a Romanian label
# does not drop an NER number yet. Not "client" alone: "Client: +40 744 ..." in a chat
# transcript is a speaker label before a phone number.
